description:
Client-side image crop dialog built on `react-easy-crop`. The user
picks a focal point and zoom level; the output is a new File with
the cropped region, preserving the source MIME type where possible.

Designed for avatar (aspect=1) and banner (aspect=3) use cases but
accepts any numeric aspect ratio.

props.name: file
props.description: The source File to crop. Dialog is open while non-null.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Aspect ratio for the crop area (1 for square, 3 for 3:1 banner).

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Closes the dialog without producing output.

props.name: onCrop
props.description: Receives the cropped File ready for upload.

props.name: description
props.defaultValue: Drag to reposition. Scroll or use the slider to zoom.
